scenes.title: Big Bang
scenes.text: The universe is about thirteen point eight billion years old, and it all began from something tiny.

scenes.title: Earth Forms
scenes.text: Earth formed four and a half billion years ago, a molten ball slowly cooling into a home for life.

scenes.title: First Life
scenes.text: Life appeared roughly three point eight billion years ago, starting as simple cells in warm water.

scenes.title: Walking
scenes.text: Our ancestors stood upright around six million years ago, freeing their hands to change everything.

scenes.title: Us
scenes.text: Modern humans appeared about three hundred thousand years ago, and we spread across the whole planet.

scenes.title: Farming
scenes.text: Farming began only ten thousand years ago, and it changed how we live more than anything before.

scenes.title: Explosion
scenes.text: In just the last century, we went from horse carts to landing rockets and connecting the world.

scenes.title: Your Slice
scenes.text: You are a tiny moment in a huge story. What will you do with the short time you have here?
